name: Race Track Mayhem
description: A toy-car racing game for kids. Pick one of five toy cars and race around five tracks set up in giant rooms of the house: the bedroom, playroom, kitchen, bathroom and living room. Loop-de-loops, corkscrews, spiral climbs, ramp jumps, boost pads and a Ready, Set, GO! countdown. Keyboard or game controller.
requirements: Graphics that support OpenGL 3.3 (almost any PC from the last 10 years)
Keyboard, or an Xbox-style game controller

credits.asset: Godot Engine (game engine, bundled in the .exe)
credits.author: Juan Linietsky, Ariel Manzur and Godot Engine contributors

credits.asset: Sound effects, voices, jingles and UI sounds
